rubric.evidence: Verified directly against WICG Iframe Media Pausing §2-3, Microsoft Edge Explainer, Blink permissions_policy_features.json5 (EnableForAll), html_media_element.cc (CanPlayWhileHidden, ProcessDeferredPlay), audio_context.cc (interrupted state & InvalidStateError), local_frame.cc (subframe hidden inheritance), runtime_enabled_features.json5 (status: stable), WPT, and ChromeStatus 5082950457884672 on 2026-11-27.

Feature 5082950457884672 is listed under 'Enabled by default' in /api/v0/features?milestone=155 with exact listing name 'Pause media playback on not-visible iframes'; slug pause-media-playback-on-not-visible-iframes matches slugify(); H1 matches listing name; declared ChromeStatus table row links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5082950457884672.

Full reference covers all 3 inventoried surfaces (media-playback-while-not-visible Permissions Policy, HTMLMediaElement/Autoplay pausing, and Web Audio AudioContext interruption) across all 9 dimensions, including the HTMLMediaElement no-auto-resume vs. AudioContext auto-resume asymmetry and deferred play()/resume() settlement.

Explains why the default allowlist is *, defines all three not-visible triggers (display: none, visibility: hidden, zero-area), compares HTMLMediaElement and AudioContext state transitions side by side, and contrasts with the abandoned execution-while-not-rendered proposal.

Provides complete HTTP/HTML embedder examples, embedded HTMLMediaElement NotAllowedError/pause handling, and Web Audio AudioContext interrupted/statechange handling verified by doc-tests.mjs, plus links to all 4 verified HTTP-200 Chrome Platform Showcase concept demos.

Honest Limited availability banner and tabular compat matrix citing ChromeStatus 5082950457884672, Blink stable flag, Mozilla positive position, WebKit no signal, missing BCD/web-features entries, and progressive-enhancement safety.
Every visible source and citation label carries a direct external <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; CPS feature root and all 4 concept demos HEAD-checked HTTP 200 on 2026-11-27.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 hierarchy, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions and <pre tabindex='0'>, and visible :focus-visible outline.

Uses shared /public/styles.css editorial tokens, logical max-inline-size sizing, and horizontally scrollable .table-wrap containers without document horizontal overflow at mobile 360x740 or desktop 1280x800.

Links to https://chrome-platform-showcase.kinlan-test.workers.dev/v137/pause-media-playback-on-not-rendered-iframes/ (and 4 concept demos, all HTTP 200; CPS conformance.json declares chromestatusId 5082950457884672). Clearly explains the Chrome 137 origin-trial slug rename (not-rendered -> not-visible) and avoids cross-milestone iframe mismatch.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible semantic HTML landmark navigation code blocks iframe embed
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use a single <main> landmark, single <h1>, sequential heading hierarchy, semantic <header>/<nav>/<footer> landmarks, and <pre tabindex='0'><code> for keyboard-accessible scrollable code blocks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: structured article with single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer class='byline'>, sequential h2/h3 headings, and <pre tabindex='0'><code> on every code block.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation table scroll focus keyboard navigation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide keyboard-focusable scrollable containers with explicit region labels and visible :focus-visible rings for wide data tables so keyboard users can scroll without horizontal document overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: wrapped every .doc-table in <div class='table-wrap' tabindex='0' role='region'> with aria-label or aria-labelledby and a 3px var(--accent-blue) :focus-visible outline.
